Subject: Vendor master intake: required docs and PO contact (BlueHolme Labs)

Hi Susan / BlueHolme team,

I’m setting up BlueHolme in our vendor master so payments and POs can flow cleanly. To complete the record we need the following canonical items from you: 

• Legal entity name as it should appear on contracts and W-9
• Registered business address (street, city, state, ZIP)
• AP / invoicing contact (name, email, phone) and preferred PO routing email
• Remittance details (ACH beneficiary name and account contact) — bank details are collected in a secure portal, we can send an invite
• A copy of your W-9 (US entities) or equivalent tax form
• Copy of articles of incorporation (or business registration) for entity proof

If you prefer, we can send a short onboarding form that collects these fields and provisions your profile into our procurement system. Once we have the legal name/address and AP contact I can provision initial PO routing ($0 test PO) so your billing team can confirm receipt.

Deadline: would you be able to provide these by EOD Wednesday 17 Jul? If not, tell me what works and we’ll adjust the intake timeline.

Thanks — attaching the vendor intake checklist for reference.

Regards,
